svg.title: Q for Quotation and Invoice Templates
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A magnifier-shaped Q reveals two illustrative document layouts, one marked quote and the other invoice. It introduces quotation and invoice template design with quote, invoice and reusable-brand-layout examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; Q silhouette and teal, charcoal, cream and amber palette adapted from 17_Q_quality_control.png; no external assets. Document examples are illustrative, not fillable or tax-compliance templates.

g.text: CLEAR, CONSISTENT AND READY TO SEND.
